# hartwig_report_germline_variant records that panel's reportGermlineVariant setting, which is why the
# existing SAGE germline output cannot serve this purpose: every gene here except TP53 is set to NONE.
# The curated 74-gene list and variant-level rules in the supplement to Vlasschaert et al, Blood 2023
# (doi:10.1182/blood.2022018825) are not open access and have not been read. This panel is therefore a
# literature-curated starting set rather than a reproduction of that standard, and should be reconciled
# with it when the supplement becomes available.
